# Healthcare Compliance Pros

> Healthcare compliance software, backed by compliance experts. Healthcare Compliance Pros (HCP) provides HIPAA, OSHA and corporate
> compliance software, role-based training and expert advisory support to
> medical practices, hospitals and health systems, medical billing companies,
> business associates and private-equity-backed healthcare platforms in the
> United States.

## What HCP does

HCP combines compliance software with a named team of 3-5 assigned compliance
advisors per client. The platform covers four connected programs:

1. HIPAA compliance - customized Privacy and Security policies, workforce
   training, Security Risk Analysis, business associate agreement tracking,
   breach risk assessment and incident management.
2. OSHA compliance - Bloodborne Pathogens exposure control, Hazard
   Communication with a virtual SDS binder, facility safety inspections,
   hazard and risk assessments, and safety training.
3. Corporate compliance - a documented program built on the seven elements of
   an effective compliance program expected by CMS and the OIG, including
   Fraud, Waste and Abuse training, an anonymous hotline, OIG/SAM exclusion
   monitoring, compliance committee records and internal auditing.
4. Learning Management System - 130+ courses with automated role-based
   assignment, reminders, certificates and AMA PRA Category 1 Credits(TM) on
   select courses.

Additional expert services include SENTRY coding audits, a Fractional
Compliance Officer engagement, on-site services, credential management and
background screening.

## What makes HCP distinct

- Every client is assigned 3-5 named compliance advisors, included in the
  subscription rather than sold as premium support.
- Audit and investigation support is included, not billed hourly during an
  active OCR, OSHA or payer audit.
- Policies are customized to specialty, headcount and state law, and are
  revised when regulations change.
- HIPAA, OSHA and corporate compliance run from one dashboard and one staff
  login rather than three separate vendors.
- Pricing scales with headcount so small independent practices receive the
  same advisors and audit support as multi-site groups.

## Compliance solutions

- [SHIELD Compliance Solution](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-solution/): One platform for HIPAA, OSHA and corporate compliance, with assigned advisors, 130+ training courses and included audit support.
- [HIPAA Compliance](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-solution/hipaa/): Customized HIPAA policies, workforce training, Security Risk Analysis, BAA tracking and breach response, backed by assigned advisors.
- [OSHA Compliance](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-solution/osha/): Bloodborne Pathogens exposure control, Hazard Communication, virtual SDS binder, safety inspections and training for clinical settings.
- [Corporate Compliance](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-solution/corporate-compliance/): A documented corporate compliance program built on the seven elements: FWA training, hotline, exclusion monitoring, auditing and committee records.
- [Learning Management System](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-solution/lms/): 130+ compliance courses with automated role-based assignment, reminders, certificates and CME credit on select titles.

## Expert services

- [The HCP Difference](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlsolutions-the-hcp-difference.html): What separates HCP from other compliance vendors: assigned advisor teams, included audit support and customized documentation that stays current.
- [Free Compliance Risk Assessment](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcompliance-assessment.html): A no-cost, no-obligation review of your HIPAA, OSHA and corporate compliance program, with a written gap analysis you keep either way.
- [SENTRY Coding Intelligence](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcoding-compliance/): Certified coder audits of E/M, modifiers and documentation, with provider-level feedback and corrective education that reduces denials.
- [Fractional Compliance Officer](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlfractional-compliance-officer/): An experienced healthcare compliance officer on a part-time basis — program ownership, committee leadership and audit response without a full-time hire.
- [On-Site Services](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlon-site-services/): In-person compliance training, mock audits, facility safety walkthroughs and program assessments delivered at your location by HCP specialists.
- [Credential Manager](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlcredential-manager/): Track licenses, certifications, DEA registrations and immunizations with automated expiration alerts and audit-ready documentation.
- [Background Checks](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlbackground-checks/): Pre-employment background checks and ongoing OIG and SAM exclusion monitoring built into your compliance program and onboarding workflow.

## Who we serve

- [Medical Practices](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlmedical-practices.html): HIPAA, OSHA and corporate compliance built for independent and group medical practices, with advisors who handle the work you cannot staff.
- [Hospitals & Health Systems](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlhospitals-health-systems.html): Department-level compliance support, standardized training and consolidated reporting for hospitals, health systems and outpatient networks.
- [Business Associates](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlbusiness-associates.html): Business associates are directly liable under HIPAA. Build a documented Security Rule program, answer client security reviews and track subcontractor BAAs.
- [Medical Billing Companies](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlmedical-billing.html): HIPAA and corporate compliance programs for billing companies: Security Rule documentation, coding integrity, FWA training and client security reviews.
- [Private Equity](https://www.healthcarecompliancepros.com/index.htmlprivateequity.html): Standardize compliance across a healthcare portfolio: diligence support, post-close integration, coding risk assessment and platform-level reporting.
